content.thinking:
I'm checking the overview's first claims against the evidence. The io-shop account page failure is tied to a new monthly spending summary setting, which the cause line and P1 support. The summary's likely failure for returning shoppers with no purchases this month, since it divides by this month's purchase count, also checks out against F1 and the cause line. I'm now moving on to the duration claim.

I'm going through the remaining overview claims: the customer-loss figure is attributed to Argus's estimate and the figures line supports it, nobody was paged so no on-call staff were pulled in, switching the setting back off didn't help so it was turned on again, and Argus's proposed fix is still an unapplied draft. Everything checks out against the record, so I'm not flagging anything.
